attributes.action: Stop expanding refugee resettlement through new "safe and legal" routes
attributes.additional_details:
Britain is already struggling with severe pressure on housing, public services and public finances. Expanding refugee resettlement would increase those pressures and put the British people at risk.

The Government should put the interests of the British people first.

Any refugees imported through this scheme must be deported.
attributes.background: Abandon any plans to expand refugee resettlement through new "safe and legal" routes.

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on this subject, which you may wish to sign:

https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/775317
